Senior Python Developer, Team Lead
Position: Senior Python Developer, Team Lead
Experience years: 11
English level: upper
Architecture and implementation of analytics dashboard based on Django, Celery and D3.js

Implemented new features to Django corporate task management system
Designed and implemented distributed CRM
Implemented business intelligence system for game application
Designed and developed RESTful API for game application
Integrated a corporate ticket system with Facebook and Twitter APIs
Designed and developed a WebSocket web chat for a corporate ticket system using JavaScript and Tornado
Wrote SQL reports for the company clients
Designed and implemented a distributed RESTful task queue based on key-value DB using Python and Lua
Supported a highload e-commerce shop
Over 10 years of experience as a Software Developer mostly using Python
Built a CI pipelines in GitLab CI with testing and code standard checks (pyflakes, pylint)
Built an infrastructure with Terraform, Ansible in various clouds (for AWS and Azure)
Built projects with microservices
Built systems with multi-threading and asynchronous approach (tornado, aiohttp, celery)
3 years of team leading of web team
Performed code review of team members
Performed staff candidates review
